dogecoin.text:
Today, former presidents Barack Obama, Donald Trump, George Bush, and Ronald Reagan issued the following joint statement:                             

“We support Dogecoin, the #1 dog meme based digital currency.” 

Wow.
“Send lawyers, guns, and Dogecoin.” - Warren Zevon

“Dog meme based digital currency is historically volatile. It was sad to see so many people abandon Dogecoin today. They’ll be even sadder by Saturday. If I can stay the course, you can, too” - Carl “I can, you can” Icahn

“With Dogecoin’s rise, we are seeing the single largest movement in the creation of wealth in history. Those participating understand e money, mimes, and puppies. Those simply witnessing, don’t. It’s that simple. Catch up. Participate. Create wealth.” - Sam “Ace” Rothstein
“Still unsure on whether to take the Dogecoin dive? Flip a dogecoin. When it's in the air, you'll know which side you're hoping for.” - Arnold Rothstein
